diagnosis: The endpoint configures a feature kill-switch for tenant_id using flag_admin_client.set_tenant_override. It fails to check that current_user has administrative authority over tenant_id, allowing any logged-in user to disable critical features (e.g. payment processing or login integrations) for other tenants.
